summary: Tested the organised Super Admin (exam > section > test structure, upload wizard, publish_ready, student-side structure) end to end, using only disposable isolated DBs (tejas_isolated_book170_<hex>, all dropped afterwards; the customer DB was never written; no real owner login). BACKEND: new isolated suite tests/structure_iso173.py passed 131 of 133 checks. It uses the real FastAPI app over ASGI, real JWT, the real PDF worker, and mocked storage and AI. What works: catalog exams for student and owner; creating a custom exam (hidden by default); duplicate name 409; built-in PATCH 422; show and hide; sections (create, rename, hide, 'Results' slug kept from colliding, partial order 409, full order 200); student sections only when live_count>0, not hidden, and in owner order; legacy placement (?section= and legacy ?kind=, plus section.layout); admin section tests with state; test order 409/200, and the student catalogue follows it; display_title shows in /api/sets/{id} and the catalogue; my/sets catalog_path; unlive removes the test from the catalogue, /api/sets/{id}, /api/my/sets/{id} and new starts (404) while old attempts stay readable, and live:true restores it; move within an exam keeps attempts; moving to another exam 409 and a non-PYQ into PYQ 409; hidden custom exam enforcement for both catalog_section_id and exam-key sets (my/sets, preflight, start, /api/sets/{id}, lists) with owner access; unplaced list; role matrix (reviewer and student get 403 on catalog, overview, books, schedule and studio/reviewers; reviewer can read review/held). Books: section_id missing, invalid, pyq, chapters or custom-chapters all get 422; destination is stored and auto_publish is forced False; the same sha returns the same book; nothing publishes after reading; publishing a held mock gives 409 with a message; publishing one ready mock works; the title equals the label, exam and section are correct, and catalog_order comes after existing tests; publish_ready with a future release_at gives a future start_at on the set and the set stays hidden from students; book-series path; a custom-exam book gets rules exam 'Custom', publishes, has exam 'TEST NEET' and can be started. FRONTEND: Playwright on the preview URL, with /api/** forwarded to an isolated bridge (tests/structure_bridge173.py on 127.0.0.1:8773) and owner, reviewer and student cookies. Works: 7-part nav; breadcrumbs on every part; no horizontal overflow at 390px on admin, wizard and student pages; new exam dialog leads to a tab with a Hidden chip; Show on Home and Hide from Home toggle; new section dialog; empty section shows 'Nothing in this section yet.' and Add content; test up/down, Live switch, rename dialog and Move select all work; the 5-step upload wizard (PYQ disabled, list types book/paper/excel, chapter types chapter/excel, destination chip, no edition/auto-publish/schedule fields) uploads a real PDF and lands on book detail with a student preview; preview rows show Ready, Held with reason and Fix, the held switch is disabled, the per-mock Live switch publishes, and Publish all ready on a later date schedules; the old 'Enable clean-mock publication' button is gone; Review tabs and held list; Schedule timed-list; Students; Team grant and remove with confirmation; the reviewer sees only Review and is redirected from every other part and from /studio; legacy links (/studio, /book-series, /book-series/{id} going to /exams/bitsat/mocks, /super-admin/uploads); a single Super Admin menu item; no Book series button; Home shows the 3 built-in cards plus a custom card only after Show; the hidden hub tells students 'Choose an available exam' and shows the owner note to the owner; hub cards come from the API with Results last; /exams/jee-main/mocks redirects to pyq; the custom section lists its test; SetDetail back goes to catalog_path. Found 2 real bugs (below).

critical.issue: A mock scheduled with per-mock release_at (publish_ready + release_at) shows as 'published' in the book view and counts. The override uses the book-level payload.release_at, which is None for new books: (p.get('release_at') or 0)<=stamp is always true. Reproduced: after publish_ready with release_at=now+1 day, the set's start_at is in the future and students cannot see it, but the API mock state is 'published' and the UI counts show '2 PUBLISHED 0 SCHEDULED'. The preview row chip shows 'Scheduled' correctly. Fix: compare against m.release_at or the set's start_at.

The legacy 'publish' action is still accepted and sets payload.auto_publish=True. book_publish.publish_ready (line 164) and book_worker.publish_batch (line 60) honour auto_publish, so any mock that becomes ready later (for example after a held mock is fixed) goes live with no owner request. This breaks the rule 'nothing goes live automatically'. Reproduced: control publish returned 200 with auto_publish true. Fix: remove 'publish' from the Control Literal, or stop it setting auto_publish.

minor.issue: If a student already has an active attempt, it is returned before the permitted/owner_unlive/hidden check. That student can keep resuming an unlived or hidden test; a new student correctly gets 404. This may be acceptable ('existing attempts stay readable'), but confirm it is intended.

For a custom-exam destination the created set keeps the detected exam (e.g. 'JEE Main') as 'exam'. Only catalog_section_id points to the custom exam. Books instead set exam = destination key. The mismatch check only covers built-in exams. Per-exam results, history and /api/sets?exam= filters will group these under the detected exam, not the custom one.

available() reads the per-process visibility cache without refreshing it. /api/sets and other list endpoints that never call visibility() depend on another request having refreshed it. This is fine with --workers 1, but in a multi-worker or multi-pod deploy, Show/Hide reaches other workers only when that worker happens to call visibility().
catalog_base = next_order() (max+1) and catalog_order = base + mock.order leave a gap of 1 after existing tests. Cosmetic only.

ui_bugs.issue: Scheduled mocks are counted as PUBLISHED (0 SCHEDULED). The cause is the backend book_view bug above.

issues: The success toast at top centre covers the breadcrumb and page header for a few seconds (seen on Content and Team).

action_items: Fix book_store.book_view so the scheduled->published override uses each mock's release_at or its set's start_at, not the book-level release_at
Remove the legacy control action 'publish' or stop it setting auto_publish=True (book_imports.py:229), so nothing can publish automatically

Update the old regression suites (book_publishing_iso170.py, book_publishing_rules_iso170.py, book_scale_iso171.py and the 170/171 bridges). They create books without section_id (now 422) and assert auto-publication, so they are obsolete as they stand. Pass section_id='bitsat:mocks' and call structure.seed() first
Decide whether custom-exam imports and chapter books should set exam = destination exam key, as books do
Optional: pluralise '1 tests'; move toasts so they do not cover the breadcrumb
critical_code_review_comments: structure.py visibility cache is per process; consider refreshing it inside available() callers (e.g. /api/sets) or using a shared TTL
update_section(hidden=True) does not stop direct links to tests in that section. Spec only requires hiding the section listing, so this is OK, but it is worth documenting
PATCH tests 'live:true' on a draft returns a note but changes nothing visible. Fine

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all listed flows work; 1 count display bug from the backend)

seed_data_creation: Only inside disposable isolated DBs (TEST_S173_* sets, TEST NEET/TEST CUET exams, TEST_QA173 books, qa170-* staff, random student phones). All DBs were dropped and verified gone. Cached originals from the isolated book uploads may remain in /tmp/jeelive-book-originals (shared cache dir, left untouched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: cd /app/backend && python tests/structure_iso173.py (about 60s, 133 checks; after the fixes it should be 133/133). The check names 'book view shows Mock 2 scheduled...' and 'legacy publish action must not re-enable auto_publish' are the two bug checks. Browser: nohup timeout 2400 python tests/structure_bridge173.py 2300 > /tmp/bridge173.log & , then read /tmp/uibridge173/bridge.json (owner/reviewer/student cookies + fx ids). In Playwright, use context.route('**/api/**') with route.fetch(url replaced to http://127.0.0.1:8773) and add_cookies with url=BASE. The bridge's PYQ fixture lacks pyq_year, so /api/pyq catalogue raises KeyError in the bridge. That is a fixture artifact, so the PYQ page UI was not checked. Not tested: Excel/paper import and chapter-book upload with section_id end to end (only the invalid pyq section_id rejection), and the app integration doc.
rca of the issue: Bug 1: book_store.book_view lines 124-125 convert state 'scheduled' to 'published' when (p.get('release_at') or 0) <= now. Phase 1 moved release_at to the mock (BookMock.release_at via publish_ready), so the book-level value is None and every scheduled mock looks published in the API and the UI counts. Bug 2: Control still allows action='publish', which sets payload.auto_publish=True. The worker and publisher still treat auto_publish as permission to publish every ready mock.
